summary: B0a game skeleton: DONE and verified in the editor and in a built player. GameDirector (contract 11.1) is the only MonoBehaviour of the scene. Awake applies the frame settings (Android: vSync 0, 60 fps or -fps, renderScale cap above 1920 px; Windows: vSync 1 and targetFrameRate -1 unless -fps), builds each subsystem in its own try/catch ('[PainterIO] <subsystem> failed: ...'; order CameraRig, LiquidRenderer, ActorViews, SteeringInput, UiRoot, Sfx, PlayerProbe, DevShot), then goes to Menu with a self-restarting attract match. It implements the state machine Boot -> Menu -> Playing -> Results, SetPaused (Runner.Paused; leaving pause goes back through the ready gate), OnApplicationPause / OnApplicationFocus (auto pause, SaveData.Flush), the ready gate (Begin on the first non-null HumanController.Desired, or after 2.5 s while RoundsPlayed < 3, else 1.0 s), SlowMo (hold then linear ramp on Runner.TimeScale, real time) with the three cut triggers of 11.1, the sleep timeout (NeverSleep only while Playing) and the results flow. That flow builds HumanOutcome once, right after the Step that eliminated the human: rank, shared rank, FinalCells area, cause, attacker from SparkCaught.Other, distance from SparkCaught.DistanceHome, stats with the 23.3 debounce (only Returns with cells count, a flicker Return never counts as a saved chase). Then a 1.0 s death beat (tap skips it) or 0.6 s on a round end, ShowResults, and stats saved unless TuningModified or a command-line override is active. GameSession and SimRunner (11.2): double accumulator, at most 8 steps per frame, Alpha, events forwarded after each Step from LastEvents with a try/catch per subscriber (each failing subscriber logged once), RenderPos and RenderSparkS. CreateRound uses the 23.3 seed rule and the lineups (players 1-3 Balanced, Greedy, Aggressive, with HumanAttackScale 0.3 while !TutExitDone), then the SaveData test settings and the -sparkFactor / -roundDuration / -ringInterval / -lasso overrides, and starts with AwaitingStart true and Runner.Paused. CreateAttract uses Balanced, Balanced, Greedy, Aggressive and starts a fresh seeded Simulation 2 s after each round end. SaveData (11.5) caches PlayerPrefs ('pio.<Name>') and wraps every access in try/catch. Palette (11.3) and LiquidLayers (11.4, QuadMesh built in code, front face toward the -Z camera) are done. DemoScenario (23.3) is the scripted demo round as SimSetup + scripted controllers + a BeforeTick lasso-charge hook at TickRate 60. Its named checkpoints are ThreadOut 150, CutDroplets 215, MidFill 294, PocketPending 520 and Caught 630, and its Monitor assertion helper has Evaluate and Report. Measured run: first cut at tick 176 (s_cut 2.28 of L 14.0, near the loop origin); saved chased return at tick 284 capturing 3826 cells (margin 0.287 s); LassoPocket at tick 494 in the second exit, 832 cells all over the rival puddle, 0.875 u from the human's puddle; second cut 1.73 u behind the head at tick 602; human eliminated by Spark at tick 624. DevShot ('-devshot <dir> [-fps n]') saves menu.png after 2 s in Menu, then runs DemoScenario as the real session and saves <Checkpoint>.png on the first rendered frame with Tick >= target. Each shot uses ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshot, then a realtime wait for the file (5 s max) plus 0.2 s with the runner paused. It also saves results.png, logs the scenario verdict, then calls Application.Quit(0). Every line starts with '[DevShot]'. Stubs written with the binding factories (header 'STUB by B0a, owned by <pkg>'): LiquidRenderer (B1), ActorViews (B2), SteeringInput (B3), UiRoot and Strings (B4; Get returns the key, Language backed by SaveData), Sfx and Haptics (B5; Pulse no-op), PlayerProbe (B6; TryCreate returns null). The CameraRig stub (B3) already creates the contract 14 main camera: orthographic, z = -50, 18 u visible width in portrait (20 u high in landscape), layer 31 culled, clear color #151D38, URP camera data off, MainCamera tag plus AudioListener, no smoothing, following the human (the leading bot in attract) and clamped to 4 u beyond the arena. AssemblyMarker.cs is gone. VERIFICATION: EditMode through tools/unity.ps1 gives JUnit tests=288, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=2 (the 2 explicit Core BotReport cases). PlayMode gives tests=3, failures=0. Builder.SetupAndCompile PASS (no error CS). BuildWindows -buildOut Build/B0a succeeded and the exe exists. The DevShot player run exited 0 in 20 s and wrote 7 PNGs (540x960). The log says 'scenario PASS' with every shot at exactly its target tick and has no exception or error. I looked at all 7 PNGs: each is uniform #151D38 (21,29,56), the clear color, as expected until B1/B2 land. The dotnet-free proof of the scenario is the EditMode test DemoScenarioTests.Demo_HeadlessRunHasTheExpectedEventsAndCheckpoints. A scratch dotnet harness (scratchpad/demo, not part of the project) was used only to tune the scenario geometry.

contract_issues: 11.2 lists 'Simulation Sim { get; }' and 'SimRunner Runner { get; }', but CreateAttract must restart itself: the attract session replaces its Simulation and SimRunner in place (private setters), raises GameSession.Restarted, and GameDirector re-raises SessionStarted with the same session. Views must read Session.Sim / Session.Runner every frame or rebind on SessionStarted, never cache them across a SessionStarted.

11.2 says HumanController is null in attract. It is also null in scripted sessions whose human is scripted (DemoScenario, the probe), because the human's controller is not an ExternalController there. HumanIndex stays 0 in those sessions.

11.1 SetPaused: the reading applied is that it is refused not only outside Playing / in attract, but also once the human is eliminated, the round ended or the results beat started (no pause panel over the death beat).

11.2 'Windows command-line overrides': LaunchArgs reads them on every platform (harmless on Android, where there is no command line). Contract 18.2 names the probe shots thread/cut/fill/pocket/results.png, while DevShot (23.3) names them after the checkpoints (ThreadOut.png, CutDroplets.png, MidFill.png, PocketPending.png, Caught.png) plus menu.png and results.png.
open_issues: DevShot images show only the clear color #151D38 until B1 (liquid) and B2 (actors) replace their stubs; there is no UI until B4. Checked: all 7 PNGs uniform (21,29,56), files written at their exact target ticks, scenario PASS, player log clean.

BootTests applies the 18.1 LiquidSurface / ActorField checks and the non-empty text checks automatically as soon as LiquidRenderer / UiRoot no longer sit on a GameObject named '... (stub)'. Until then they are skipped with a '[BootTests] ... still the B0a stub' log line. B1 and B4 must name their roots without '(stub)', and their first PlayMode run will exercise these checks.

Player names come from Strings.Get('name.you') and Strings.Get('name.colorN'). With the Strings stub they read as the keys. Names are fixed when a session is created, so a language switch applies to the next session.
The death-beat camera hold and the results zoom are B3's (GameDirector.InResultsBeat and StateChanged give the timing).

Test counts: EditMode 288 in the JUnit report, 286 executed and green plus 2 explicit Core cases skipped by design. PlayMode 3/3. Added by B0a: 13 EditMode (S4Display 1, DemoScenario 3, RuntimeSkeleton 9) and 3 PlayMode. 'passing' = 286 + 3.
